You can view the interactive Graphify knowledge graph in a web browser using any of the following methods:

---

### Option 1: Open Directly in Your Browser (Quickest)

Open the standalone HTML visualizer directly:

* **File Path**: [`file:///home/prem/Projects/AppleTV/graphify-out/graph.html`](file:///home/prem/Projects/AppleTV/graphify-out/graph.html) *(or [`index.html`](file:///home/prem/Projects/AppleTV/graphify-out/index.html))*

You can launch it from your Linux terminal using:
```bash
xdg-open /home/prem/Projects/AppleTV/graphify-out/graph.html
```
*(Or specify your browser directly, e.g., `google-chrome /home/prem/Projects/AppleTV/graphify-out/graph.html` or `firefox /home/prem/Projects/AppleTV/graphify-out/graph.html`)*

---

### Option 2: Serve via a Local Web Server

If your browser restricts local `file://` permissions for embedded scripts or data:

1. Run a lightweight Python HTTP server from the project directory:
   ```bash
   python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory /home/prem/Projects/AppleTV/graphify-out
   ```
2. Open your browser and navigate to:
   ```
   http://localhost:8000/graph.html
   ```

---

### Option 3: Read the Text Summary & Metrics
